messages:
Maya: Quick sync — final internal release notes and comms for tomorrow's 10:00 PT deploy. Need ack and any callouts. :clock10:
Simon: ack. proposing we pin model to redwood/open-v2@v2.14.2 and runtime artifact rfi-2026-03-20b. objections?
Lena: product ok. can we include a concise impact line for the internal blurb (one sentence)?
Rachel: draft below — please edit.
Rachel: "Internal: Deploy scheduled 10:00 PT tomorrow for runtime + serving fixes — expect ~12% median token latency improvement and a fix for embeddings quota edge-case. No UI changes; short-lived restarts possible for some batch jobs. On-call will watch."
Tom: ops: set canary at +0m, full rollout at +15m, auto-rollback if error rate >1.2% OR p99 > 1.1s. Smoke tests to gate.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled -> 2026-03-20 17:00 UTC (root: 4298765432). Full rollout -> +15m. Rollback hooks and webhooks configured. :gear:
Nick: oncall here. If batch jobs restart, will they pick up where they left off or require manual resubmit?
Maya: streaming clients reconnect automatically; batch jobs that hit EOF will need a manual restart. adding note to RN.
Rachel: updated blurb: "Batch inference jobs interrupted by the deploy may require manual restart; streaming sessions should reconnect automatically."
Lena: can we add short tech bullets for the RN? e.g., kernel selector fix, KV pruning, model pin.
Rachel: adding tech bullets now:
```
- Runtime: kernel-selection fix to reduce OOMs on long-sequence traces
- Serving: KV cache pruning improvements to cut duplicated tokens
- Model: pinned redwood/open-v2 -> v2.14.2 (fallback v2.13.9)
- Docs: migration notes updated for private deployment customers
```
Simon: LGTM. comms plan: internal blast to #general and #ops, and note in weekly digest. customers only notified 1h after successful rollout unless regressions.
Maya: agree. I'll post internal announce at 08:50 PT unless objections.
Tom: smoke tests set. if canary smoke fails -> auto-rollback and alert. if full smoke fails -> page SRE.
Nick: I'll be on pager. please @me when canary starts.
Maya: posting at 08:50 PT. action list:
- Rachel: finalize RN and post internal blast by 08:50 PT
- Tom: confirm deploybot schedule + smoke (done)
- Simon: pin artifacts in CI and update release manifest (done)
- Nick: standby for pager (done)
deploy-bot: Announce posted to #general and #ops at 08:51 PT. Thread: 4298765432-announce.
Maya: thanks everyone — monitoring metrics and will close thread after 1hr stable. :rocket:
